summary.headline: EuBiologics signs KRW 10.1bn oral cholera vaccine supply deal with UNICEF, term extended to Apr 30, 2027
summary.what_happened: EuBiologics Co., Ltd. filed a corrected disclosure of a single supply contract for its oral cholera vaccine (YuBiocol-S) with UNICEF for delivery in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. The contract was signed on Jul 13, 2026, and the filing amends the contract end date from Dec 31, 2026 to Apr 30, 2027. Payment is due within 30 days after submission of supporting documents, and no advance payment applies.
summary.why_it_matters: Supply contracts disclosed under this category typically indicate the size of a company's individual orders relative to its revenue, and corrections to contract terms such as end dates are usually made to reflect updated delivery schedules. Shareholders generally look at such filings to understand order flow and contract timing.
